import into a nonempty store creates a separate workspace, remaps every colliding ID deterministically, resolves remapped references, copies text, imports no conversations, and leaves the origin workspace untouched

limitations: Research execution is explicitly authorized host execution, not a conversation sandbox.
Declared input capture is bounded and does not claim transitive dependency completeness or snapshot consistency.
Numeric binding coverage begins with selected headline links; unlinked claims remain unknown.
Zotero is read-only metadata import with no credentials, attachment fetch or write-back.
Theory records are working notes with researcher-owned status; check receipts label evidence scope and never verify mathematics. Numerical checks cover tested instances only.
Exchange packages carry evidence copies, not reproducibility: declared inputs, execution profiles, and machine settings are excluded and listed; imported executions never run.
Conflict resolution replaces only project records and notes; immutable papers, executions, sources, and ledger entries keep the local version.
